details.description: OpenChat-3.5-0106 is a 7-billion-parameter chat model from the open-source OpenChat project, fine-tuned from Mistral-7B-v0.1 using C-RLFT (Conditioned Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning), a method its developers describe as inspired by offline reinforcement learning. Released in January 2024, it is the third release in the OpenChat 3.5 line, following OpenChat-3.5 and OpenChat-3.5-1210. It offers two chat modes: a default mode for coding and general tasks, and a separate mode tuned for mathematical reasoning.
advantages: Scores 71.3% on HumanEval, per the OpenChat-3.5-0106 model card.
Scores 77.4% on GSM8K and 65.8% on MMLU, per the model card.
The model card's benchmark table shows a higher overall average score (64.5) than the earlier OpenChat-3.5-1210 (63.8) and OpenChat-3.5 (61.6) releases.
use_cases: Mathematical reasoning via a dedicated math mode

sources.title: imoneoi/openchat: OpenChat: Advancing Open-source Language Models with Mixed-Quality Data

notes: Fireworks' page confirms fireworks/openchat-3p5-0106-7b maps to openchat/openchat-3.5-0106 and matches the catalog's 8192-token max_input/max_output. The model card does not state a supported-language list, so languages is left empty. Released January 2024. Correction: a newer OpenChat release does exist — OpenChat 3.6 (Llama-3 8B based, released 2024/05/22) — per the project's GitHub README, but that same README's 'currently supported models' list still includes openchat_3.5 -> openchat/openchat-3.5-0106, and nothing marks this model deprecated, legacy or superseded.
